usedFor: Seven Time holds work orders, and Google Docs gets each “New Work Order” via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Work Order” in Seven Time, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each work order is written into a doc tab, so crews have a written order to follow.

watchOut: “New Work Order” is polling, so the doc changes after a scheduled check, not at once.
